intendedUse: Signup/settings academic profile, guided session planning, exam planner routing, language-sensitive tutoring
coreRule: Store only basic country/curriculum/class/language in user settings. Ask detailed goals in the session or exam planner.

interactionModel.setup: Students describe their situation once in a freeform session brief instead of answering many setup questions.
interactionModel.teaching: AI drives the session with contextual buttons, MCQs, flashcards, visuals, study maps, and weak-topic review.
interactionModel.language: Teach in the selected study language unless the user explicitly asks to switch.
interactionModel.visualPolicy: Automatically use SVG figures, Mermaid diagrams, charts, tables, or image analysis when relevant.
